title: Barney's small group out of the Ellington band
summary: The recording group was billed under Bigard's name; he remembers Whetsol, Tricky Sam, Duke and Sonny, and a second group with Tizol, Ben Webster and Rex Stewart.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Oh. Which was called what? I think I have some 78's with your name --
It was called "Mood Indi-" -- BARNEY'S on the Syncopators, I think, that day they used to call me or something like that. Oh, well.
Well, your group was -- Was Barney's Syncopators a group out of the Ellington band?
I think Whetsol and Tricky and myself, Duke and Sonny and -- about all. And they had another group with Tizol, Ben Webster, and somebody else was there. Its alright. Dottie?
